title: Corporate donor eligibility at the actual donation date
if_observation: IF a reported accepted corporate donation identifies an exact company registration number, and independent evidence suggests one of the applicable corporate-donor criteria was not satisfied at receipt.
then_expected: THEN check the exact donor entity, incorporation/registration and actual UK business activity at receipt, alongside acceptance, returns and amendments, before describing an unresolved eligibility problem.
basis: Electoral Commission Great Britain guidance lists registration, UK incorporation and UK business activity as separate criteria. This is a conditional eligibility test; historical statutory scope, recipient type and disposition must be verified. The attempted current statutory page failed to render, so no universal current-law determination is claimed.
join: EC donation record and company reg. no. → exact Companies House company number and incorporation record → receipt/accepted/returned/dealt-with dates → activity evidence for that entity/period. Brand, officer, parent or overseas branch identity cannot silently replace the actual donor.
timing_geography: Great Britain party-donation route described by the cited guidance; other recipient types, Northern Ireland provisions and historical eligibility must be checked separately. The relevant date is receipt under applicable rules, not publication or today.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Wrong donor or company number", "UK-incorporated subsidiary confused with overseas parent", "Dormant accounts yet actual qualifying business", "Nonprofit business activity", "Returned/corrected donation", "Different historical or recipient-specific rule", "Registered overseas establishment confused with UK incorporation"]
required_original_records: ["Original donation and disposition/amendments", "Official incorporation/company record at receipt", "Affirmative period-specific business evidence if testing activity", "Applicable recipient/date rule and exceptions"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the reported company number and returned/accepted fields first. A foreign-incorporated donor record may provide a more decisive eligibility question than dormant accounts. Do not treat dormant status alone as proof of no business.
novelty: S06 already explicitly requires donor eligibility, incorporation evidence and refund checks. This is a useful non-sanctions implementation refinement of that predicate, not a new mechanism.
access_evidence: Official guidance and a public donation-detail template confirm relevant fields. No donation/company pair retrieved. Current statutory direct-page access failed; dated 2024 text and current regulator guidance are not a case-law conclusion.

title: An express sovereign guarantee disclosure versus the operative instrument
if_observation: IF a sovereign report expressly states that no specified guarantees exist, or supplies a demonstrably complete guarantee schedule for a defined perimeter/date, while an original executed instrument establishes a potentially in-scope guarantee.
then_expected: THEN establish enforceability, guarantor, covered liability, outstanding exposure and dates, and reconcile the exact instrument with all incorporated schedules and amendments before identifying an omission.
basis: A material unaccounted contingent public liability can affect public finance and investors. No blanket guarantee-reporting duty is inferred from Form 18-K: its categories and exceptions matter. A contract commitment, public-enterprise borrowing or government ownership alone does not establish sovereign guaranteed debt.
join: AidData contract/document ID → original loan/guarantee number, signing parties and guarantee clause or separate instrument → sovereign legal guarantor → EDGAR sovereign CIK/accession/report and exact disclosure perimeter/date → liability status and reporting currency. IMF country-series code supplies context, not a loan-level identity join.
timing_geography: Same government/perimeter, report as-of date and operative guarantee interval; distinguish central/general government, SOE own debt, guaranteed debt, direct debt and undrawn commitment. Guarantee and loan effectiveness, release, refinancing and amendments need evidence.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Letter of support rather than enforceable guarantee", "Guarantor is a different public body", "Guarantee not effective, expired or released", "Liability repaid or outside stated reporting perimeter", "Disclosed in incorporated annex", "No disbursement where report counts only outstanding drawn debt", "Valuation/currency or contingent/direct-debt distinction"]
required_original_records: ["Original executed guarantee and referenced loan", "Effectiveness/signature authority and amendments", "Evidence of covered outstanding obligation at report date", "Exact report assertion and all incorporated schedules", "Perimeter/valuation rules"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the precise no-guarantees assertion or schedule definition before looking for a loan match. Then read the original guarantee; stop if there is only a financing announcement or an unverified database classification.
novelty: N01 reconciles aid reporting, E09 compares public funding with company accounts, and X14 compares copies of the same audited statement. This tests an explicit contingent-liability disclosure against a separate operative guarantee instrument.
access_evidence: AidData documents access to original contracts; the current SEC Form 18-K was read as a blank form, with OMB expiry January 31, 2029. No contract-report pair acquired. Its external-funded-debt item excludes intergovernmental debt; completeness cannot be presumed.

title: A unit availability statement versus its contemporaneous output
if_observation: IF a precise contemporaneous disclosure says a particular generation unit has zero available capacity over a stated interval and a quality-controlled series appears to report actual output from that same unit during it.
then_expected: THEN reconcile EIC hierarchy, measurement interval, statement version and outage revisions before describing an unresolved status/output contradiction.
basis: An inaccurate availability disclosure can matter to market transparency, but positive generation does not by itself prove manipulation, profits or a reporting violation.
join: Issuer statement and unit designation → verified unit-level EIC → production/generation-unit hierarchy → actual generation interval/value/quality and outage record/version. Country or plant aggregate must not substitute for the specified generating unit.
timing_geography: Common time zone, interval convention and contemporary statement revision; distinguish production unit, generating unit, MW available capacity and MWh/average-MW actual generation.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Other unit within same plant", "Partial derating rather than zero availability", "Testing or permitted trial operation", "Stale/cancelled notice or revision", "Timestamp/interval error", "Gross/net or telemetry correction", "Statement described future planned outage"]
required_original_records: ["Original timestamped statement", "Unit identity/hierarchy", "Historical notice revisions", "Quality-controlled unit output and unit semantics", "Relevant duty before any legal claim"]
next_cheapest_check: Confirm exact unit-level identity and whether the statement actually says zero. Defer if only plant totals or a current revised page are available.
novelty: R14 status-versus-operation refinement. Publication-delay compliance and operator trading profits are separately deferred/rejected, not inferred from this check.
access_evidence: ENTSO-E current documentation describes unit and outage products and platform migration; historical export/API access remains credentialed or unverified. No data or credentials requested.

title: Charity assets transferred as a candidate-campaign contribution
if_observation: IF original records attribute a direct campaign contribution to a specifically identified organization that was subject to section 501(c)(3) at the transfer date, and identify the candidate campaign receiving it. Distinguish a completed transfer from one never completed or misattributed; a later refund does not erase the original completed event.
then_expected: THEN reconcile the organization’s actual asset transfer with the campaign receipt and any refund, verifying historical tax status, legal entities, authorization, purpose and applicable rules.
basis: IRS guidance distinguishes prohibited candidate-campaign intervention from permitted nonpartisan activity. The question is actual organizational assets supporting a campaign, not whether staff hold political views. No inference is made from worship communications, employment, an affiliate’s spending or an ordinary charitable grant.
join: Form 990 EIN and legal name → verified donor legal entity and historical tax status → original FEC receipt transaction/report and committee ID → underlying organizational transfer/purpose. FEC employer text is not donor identity; FEC committee IDs and EINs are not a shared namespace.
timing_geography: US organization and candidate-campaign transaction date, historical tax classification and actual recipient role. A current IRS BMF status is not historical proof. Distinguish campaign contribution from commercial payment, refund, conduit or personal funds.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Individual donor merely lists charity as employer", "Separate 501(c)(4) affiliate or different entity", "Misattributed or never-completed receipt; a later refund may remedy consequences but does not erase a completed contribution", "Commercial payment misclassified as contribution", "Tax status different at transfer", "Nonpartisan activity or restricted charitable grant", "Unauthorized personal funds rather than charity assets"]
required_original_records: ["Actual organization-origin transfer and authorization/purpose", "Original campaign receipt, amendments and refunds", "Organization EIN/legal-entity bridge", "Applicable historical exemption evidence", "Committee identity/type and contemporaneous legal scope"]
next_cheapest_check: Open the original receipt and determine whether the donor is the organization or an individual. Only then verify EIN, tax classification and organizational funding; stop on employer-only matches.
novelty: X05 checks a charity’s legislative-lobbying declaration. This tests a different underlying transaction and candidate-campaign asset restriction, without requiring a contradictory Form 990 answer. E08 related-party overlap alone does not establish this conduct.
access_evidence: IRS and FEC documentation inspected; no organization or transaction searched. Historical exemption evidence/underlying transfer can require additional records. IRS historical status/determination evidence is a supporting route, explicitly outside the Form 990 file alone.

title: A covered licence transfer before its required consent
if_observation: IF an operative contract expressly requires identified consent before a defined assignment/change of control and the corresponding completed transaction and consent chronology can be established.
then_expected: THEN compare closing/effectiveness with the actual consent or valid deemed-consent process after resolving carve-outs, waivers and amendments.
basis: The test concerns compliance with a particular prerequisite. An investor-name change or lack of a consent document in one archive does not establish an unauthorized transfer.
join: Original contract/right/permit → exact covered legal entity and transaction definition → issuer filing/exhibit with closing date → consent authority/instrument and notice receipt chronology. Land Matrix deal ID is only a lead, not a contract-number crosswalk or closing proof.
timing_geography: Contract and amendments in force at actual legal transfer, with governing law, notice/deemed-consent periods and intra-group exemptions.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Share sale not covered assignment", "Intra-group exemption", "Condition precedent delays effectiveness", "Consent in undiscovered amendment", "Valid deemed consent", "Transaction announced but never closed", "Different licence or parcel"]
required_original_records: ["Original contract and operative amendments", "Executed transfer/closing evidence", "Consent or deemed-consent notification records", "Exact licence/party bridge"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the full assignment/change-control clause before matching deal names. Reject the candidate if the transaction is outside its definition.
novelty: X07 prerequisite-before-action refinement; this is not new merely because the action is a legal transfer rather than construction.
access_evidence: ResourceContracts warns OCR/annotations and contract collections are incomplete. No operative transaction/consent pair acquired; missing archive entry cannot prove absence.

title: Recognized compensation and actual possession chronology
if_observation: IF an applicable project instrument identifies an eligible claim and makes compensation availability a prerequisite to possession, and the actual possession date and compensation disposition are documented.
then_expected: THEN reconcile that claim’s compensation availability, approved escrow or in-kind settlement with possession timing and amendments; distinguish a missing receipt from compensation never made available.
basis: Potential harm from premature dispossession requires a real claimant/parcel and operative requirement. The cited 2018 guidance reproduces both the sequencing provision and an exceptional escrow route; guidance is not itself the applicable project agreement.
join: World Bank project ID → operative plan/claimant or parcel ID → award/entitlement and payment availability or escrow confirmation → actual possession event and date. Do not publish personal bank details or infer claimant identity from imagery/population.
timing_geography: Applicable safeguard regime, recognized entitlement, dated possession and documented payment/escrow conditions; separate inventory observation date from legal eligibility cutoff.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Approved exceptional escrow", "Compensation offered/made available but refused", "Disputed claimant with lawful interim arrangement", "In-kind settlement", "Different parcel/claimant", "Possession date mistaken", "Framework or plan not applicable"]
required_original_records: ["Applicable project agreement/plan and entitlement", "Claim/parcel crosswalk", "Compensation availability/settlement or actual escrow evidence", "Bank approval where required", "Actual possession record and date"]
next_cheapest_check: Check the recognized claim and compensation disposition before measuring satellite change. A budget allocation or planned payment is not evidence of availability or escrow deposit.
novelty: Refinement of X02 obligation-versus-receipt and X07 prerequisite sequence. No new mechanism counted for changing the beneficiary to a displaced claimant.
access_evidence: Official guidance inspected; no project claim/receipt pair retrieved. Claimant-level payment records may be private or unpublished; no access request or outreach made.

title: A specific insurance risk answer versus contemporaneous site evidence
if_observation: IF an authenticated insurance application expressly denies a narrowly defined site condition at a stated date and an authenticated contemporaneous engineering record appears to establish that condition for the insured site.
then_expected: THEN compare the actual question, answer, insured risk and operative date with the engineering evidence and dispute disposition, separately testing knowledge, materiality and any applicable legal duty.
basis: Potentially misleading risk information can affect who pays for a major loss. A hazard, allegation or later accident is not proof of a false answer or invalid policy.
join: Court + docket + exhibit number → signed application/policy and site schedule → exact tailings facility/permit/location → engineering report/version/date. Parent company identity or nearby coordinates alone do not identify the insured risk.
timing_geography: Actual question/representation date and knowledge qualifier, not later loss date; original policy law and amendments govern any legal consequence.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Question has narrower meaning", "Different insured site or operating entity", "Report after the representation", "Contested engineering conclusion", "Disclosure in an attachment", "Knowledge/materiality not established", "Application amended before binding"]
required_original_records: ["Signed application and complete question context", "Policy/site schedule", "Authenticated engineering report", "Disposition and relevant amendments", "Applicable duty and materiality evidence before legal conclusion"]
next_cheapest_check: Check whether the public docket already contains the actual application and report. A complaint summary is insufficient; do not invoke paid PACER fetch if originals are unavailable.
novelty: Refinement of P05 precise assertion versus established finding; no new mechanism counted for changing the audience to an insurer.
access_evidence: Court archive structure documented, but no policy/application pair searched. RECAP fetch can purchase PACER material; this route was not used. Tailings portal does not supply insurance terms.
